addon.name: Takes for Blender
addon.tagline: Manage Scenes, Actions, and Render Variations

operators.name: TKS_OT_AcceptSyncPresetProperty
operators.bl_description: Save this value and apply to all scenes using the same preset

operators.name: TKS_OT_AcceptSyncPresetType
operators.bl_description: Save this category and apply to all scenes using the same preset

operators.name: TKS_OT_AcceptSyncPresets
operators.bl_description: Save all changed presets and apply to all scenes using them

operators.name: TKS_OT_ActionlessToAuto
operators.bl_description: Hand this object back to the takes. It picks the take's action up again on the next switch

operators.name: TKS_OT_ActivateTake
operators.bl_description:
Activate a Take, applying its cascade overrides.
Deactivates the previously active take in the same list.
Click the live Take again to turn every Take off - the View Layer's own assignments apply

operators.name: TKS_OT_AddNewContextItem
operators.bl_description: Add a new item (Ctrl+N) — creates what fits the current tree selection

operators.name: TKS_OT_AddRenderVersionNote
operators.bl_description: Add a note for the current render version; past versions stay listed in the history popover

operators.name: TKS_OT_AdoptedDrop
operators.bl_description:
Hand every adopted object back to the takes
Asks again first and says how many it will let go of

operators.name: TKS_OT_AdoptedKeep
operators.bl_description:
Leave every adopted object in All Takes
This is also what happens if you simply close the card

operators.name: TKS_OT_AdoptedToOneTake
operators.bl_description:
Move every adopted object onto the take you are in now
In every other take they follow the take again

operators.name: TKS_OT_ApplyRenderPreset
operators.bl_description: Apply a render preset to current scene

operators.name: TKS_OT_ArchiveRenderVersions
operators.bl_description:
Move every render version except the current and locked ones into an archive folder beside them
Files are moved, never deleted; a confirm dialog lists exactly what moves where

operators.name: TKS_OT_AssignExistingAction
operators.bl_description: Select an existing Action to assign

operators.name: TKS_OT_BatchSetTag
operators.bl_description: Apply tag to all selected View Layers

operators.name: TKS_OT_BulkMergeIntoCascade
operators.bl_description: Merge all mismatching actions in the Watchlist into the Cascade Action

operators.name: TKS_OT_CalibrateRenderTimes
operators.bl_description:
Measure render times with a headless Blender
It probe-renders each queued view layer at a tiny resolution and extrapolates to the real settings
The foreground stays responsive; ETAs update per row as results land

operators.name: TKS_OT_PreloadViewLayersCancel
operators.bl_description: Stop the view layer preload. Layers already prepared stay prepared

operators.name: TKS_OT_CategoryPopover
operators.bl_description: Grouped action assignment for all targets within a category

operators.name: TKS_OT_CleanEmpty
operators.bl_description:
Delete empty slots, then delete actions that become empty
Respects the inspector's filters
Preserves bound slots, fake-user-protected actions, and cascade-bound actions

operators.name: TKS_OT_CleanEmptyActions
operators.bl_description:
Delete actions visible in the current list that contain no slots
Fake-user-protected actions and actions referenced by any cascade tier are preserved

operators.name: TKS_OT_CleanEmptySlots
operators.bl_description:
Delete empty slots visible in the current list (respects action and name filters)
Slots currently assigned to a data-block are preserved

operators.name: TKS_OT_CleanupIncompatiblePresets
operators.bl_description:
Migrate or quarantine preset files this add-on can no longer read.
Outdated/foreign preset JSON is upgraded to the current format where possible; the rest is moved to a _quarantine folder. Nothing is deleted

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearAllMissingPresets
operators.bl_description: Clear all stale preset references in the scene

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearAllRestKeysForVL
operators.bl_description:
Clear all rest keys for objects in the current view layer
Removes each visible object's slot from the Rest State action

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearInspectorSearch
operators.bl_description: Clear the Inspector search filter and source filter

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearMissingPreset
operators.bl_description: Clear all stale references to a specific missing preset

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearPycache
operators.bl_description: Delete all __pycache__ folders (forces fresh bytecode on next restart)

operators.name: TKS_OT_ClearSlot
operators.bl_description: Clear the action slot assignment

operators.name: TKS_OT_CopyLinkedNames
operators.bl_description: Copy the names of these linked objects to the clipboard, one per line

operators.name: TKS_OT_CopySlotKeys
operators.bl_description: Copy all keyframes from the selected slot to clipboard

operators.name: TKS_OT_CreateRenderPreset
operators.bl_description: Create a new preset from current render settings

operators.name: TKS_OT_CreateTake
operators.bl_description:
Create a new Take for the specified view layer.
Creates a blank take snapshot. If no take list exists yet, one is created for the Scene+View Layer pair

operators.name: TKS_OT_DatablockClear
operators.bl_description: Clear action or slot from a specific data-block target

operators.name: TKS_OT_DatablockNewAction
operators.bl_description: Create a new action for a specific data-block target

operators.name: TKS_OT_DatablockPopover
operators.bl_description: Action assignment for a specific data-block target

operators.name: TKS_OT_DeleteAllInspectorKeys
operators.bl_description:
Delete all keyframes for the selected target.

Click: Selected datatype at current frame
Alt: ALL datatypes at current frame
Shift: Selected datatype across ENTIRE timeline
Shift+Alt: ALL datatypes across ENTIRE timeline

operators.name: TKS_OT_DeleteRenderPreset
operators.bl_description: Permanently delete this preset file

operators.name: TKS_OT_DeleteRestSlot
operators.bl_description:
Delete the Rest State slot(s) for the scope's objects — every rest key they hold
Asks for confirmation

operators.name: TKS_OT_DeleteScene
operators.bl_description: Remove the selected Scene(s)

operators.name: TKS_OT_DeleteTagItem
operators.bl_description: Delete the selected tag or group (DEL / X)

operators.name: TKS_OT_DeleteTake
operators.bl_description:
Delete a Take.
If the deleted take was active, activates the previous take.
Cannot delete the last remaining take — delete the take list instead

operators.name: TKS_OT_DeleteTreeItem
operators.bl_description:
Delete the selected item (DEL / X).
Works in both tree view and split view. In split view, acts on whichever list was last clicked

operators.name: TKS_OT_DeleteViewLayer
operators.bl_description: Remove the selected View Layer

operators.name: TKS_OT_DetectRenderVersion
operators.bl_description: Scan the output folder for existing versions and continue from the highest one found

operators.name: TKS_OT_DiffStateKindLink
operators.bl_description: Drop this object kind's own marks and follow the master default again

operators.name: TKS_OT_DiffStateKindUnlink
operators.bl_description: Give this object kind its own marks, starting from the master default

operators.name: TKS_OT_DuplicateTake
operators.bl_description:
Duplicate a Take, copying all its cascade overrides.
The duplicate is appended at the end of the take list and named with a '.001' suffix

operators.name: TKS_OT_DuplicateTreeItem
operators.bl_description:
Duplicate the selected item (Shift+D / Alt+D).
Acts on the blue-bar selection in the tree, not the active View Layer.
Shift+D: Full Copy (scenes) / Copy (view layers)
Alt+D: Linked Copy (scenes) / Copy (view layers — no linked concept)

operators.name: TKS_OT_EditOutputFault
operators.bl_description: Edit only the faulty output path field in a small pop-up; Apply writes it where it is stored

operators.name: TKS_OT_EditRenderPreset
operators.bl_description: Rename or relocate this preset

operators.name: TKS_OT_FindActionSlot
operators.bl_description:
Find and select the action and slot for a data-block

Click: the active object
Shift+Click: Scene and World
Alt+Click: turn on Follow Selection

operators.name: TKS_OT_FixOutputFault
operators.bl_description: Repair this output path where it is stored: in the scene's Output fields, or in the preset file that sets it

operators.name: TKS_OT_FixOutputFaults
operators.bl_description: Repair every faulty output path of this scene, or of every scene, where each is stored

operators.name: TKS_OT_GlobalMultiselect
operators.bl_description: Toggle multi-select mode

operators.name: TKS_OT_GlobalPromptPopover
operators.bl_description: Choose the prompts the assistant follows for every Scene

operators.name: TKS_OT_GlobalSelectAll
operators.bl_description:
Tick every visible row of the multi-selection. Rows hidden by a filter or inside a collapsed scene are left alone.
Only available while multi-select is on

operators.name: TKS_OT_GroupScenes
operators.bl_description:
Create a new Scene Group from the selected scenes.
Requires multi-select with at least two scenes selected. Members leave their current group and join the new one

operators.name: TKS_OT_GroupVLs
operators.bl_description:
Create a new View Layer Group from the selected view layers.
Requires multi-select with at least two View Layers selected from the same scene

operators.name: TKS_OT_InspectorDummy
operators.bl_description: Reserved for an upcoming feature

operators.name: TKS_OT_InvertMultiselect
operators.bl_description:
Flip every visible tick in the multi-selection: ticked rows become unticked and unticked become ticked.
Only available while multi-select is on

operators.name: TKS_OT_KeepAllUnsavedMoves
operators.bl_description: Keep every unsaved move by writing it as a real keyframe at the current frame

operators.name: TKS_OT_KeepUnsavedMove
operators.bl_description: Keep this moved value by writing it as a real keyframe at the current frame

operators.name: TKS_OT_LetGoAllUnsavedMoves
operators.bl_description: Snap every unsaved move back to its keyed value now, instead of losing it to the next frame change

operators.name: TKS_OT_MergeActions
operators.bl_description:
Fold the slots of the ticked Actions into one Action

Every object, material and world keeps its animation and follows to the Action you choose

operators.name: TKS_OT_MergeSceneGroup
operators.bl_description: Merge a Scene Group into another Scene Group (moves all member scenes)

operators.name: TKS_OT_MoveTag
operators.bl_description: Move tag or group up or down within its category

operators.name: TKS_OT_MSWAcceptAll
operators.bl_description: Let every swap go whose material slot was removed

operators.name: TKS_OT_MSWAddObject
operators.bl_description: Add the active object to the swap list

operators.name: TKS_OT_MSWDismissMoved
operators.bl_description:
Close the Swap Lists Moved card
The lists stay in their takes

operators.name: TKS_OT_MSWRemoveObject
operators.bl_description:
Remove this object and all its swap rows
Every swapped slot goes back to its original material first

operators.name: TKS_OT_MSWRemoveSlot
operators.bl_description:
Remove this material slot from the object
When more than one take has set a swap on it, they are named first

operators.name: TKS_OT_MSWRestoreAll
operators.bl_description: Put every removed slot back, each with its material and its swap

operators.name: TKS_OT_MSWSettleOrphan
operators.bl_description: Settle this swap, whose material slot was removed

operators.name: TKS_OT_MSWSettleSlot
operators.bl_description: Settle this lost slot for every take that was swapping it, in one answer

operators.name: TKS_OT_NewAction
operators.bl_description: Create a new empty Action

operators.name: TKS_OT_NewTakeFromHere
operators.bl_description:
Start the next review round from this take.
Copies every override, rule, variant and preset, names the copy by the take naming template, makes it active, and starts it with a fresh empty feedback note

operators.name: TKS_OT_ObjectActionPopover
operators.bl_description:
Set action for this object
An object left without one is fine: the take let its own action go because it was never yours, and an action is made for the object the moment you animate it

operators.name: TKS_OT_ObjectSlotPopover
operators.bl_description: Set action slot for this object

operators.name: TKS_OT_ObjectsSettingsPopover
operators.bl_description: Configure Watchlist display — columns, compact mode, cascade steps

operators.name: TKS_OT_OpenAddonPresetsFolder
operators.bl_description: Open the Add-on presets folder in your file explorer

operators.name: TKS_OT_OpenProjectPresetsFolder
operators.bl_description:
Open the Project presets folder in your file explorer.
Save the .blend file first — the Project folder lives next to it

operators.name: TKS_OT_OpenSlotMenu
operators.bl_description: Open the slot selection menu

operators.name: TKS_OT_PasteSlotKeys
operators.bl_description: Paste copied keyframes into the selected slot (replaces existing)

operators.name: TKS_OT_PreloadViewLayers
operators.bl_description:
Pre-build view layers so the first switch to each take is instant.
Runs quietly in the background without changing the layer you're on.
With a section, preloads just that scene / group; otherwise every layer

operators.name: TKS_OT_PresetCaptureReport
operators.bl_description:
Diagnostic: report preset properties that capture can't store.
Runs a capture of every preset type against the current scene and lists the writable properties whose value type is dropped (not stored in the preset), so missing-value gaps can be found before extending the serializer. Results go to the console / log (FEATURES·PRESET) plus a summary

operators.name: TKS_OT_PresetLockedInfo
operators.bl_description:
Shared folder is locked.
Unlock it in Add-on Preferences to save changes

operators.name: TKS_OT_PresetStateInfo
operators.bl_description: Show preset state information

operators.name: TKS_OT_PromptApplyText
operators.bl_description: Save the text from the Text Editor into the prompt

operators.name: TKS_OT_PromptDelete
operators.bl_description: Delete the prompt file. Levels that name it keep the name and show it as missing

operators.name: TKS_OT_PromptDiscardText
operators.bl_description: Close the Text Editor copy without saving it

operators.name: TKS_OT_PromptEditText
operators.bl_description: Open the prompt's text in a Text Editor window

operators.name: TKS_OT_PromptPick
operators.bl_description: Pick another prompt of this kind to look at

operators.name: TKS_OT_PromptPopover
operators.bl_description: Choose the prompts the assistant follows for this Scene

operators.name: TKS_OT_PromptRename
operators.bl_description: Rename the prompt. Levels of this file that name it follow; other files keep the old name and show it as missing

operators.name: TKS_OT_PromptRuleSet
operators.bl_description: Set the prompt a prompt rule gives for one kind

operators.name: TKS_OT_PromptSave
operators.bl_description: Create a prompt file, or replace the text of an existing one. Without a name it makes a new prompt of the selected kind

operators.name: TKS_OT_PromptSearch
operators.bl_description: Search the saved prompts of one kind and pick one

operators.name: TKS_OT_PromptSet
operators.bl_description: Pick the prompt the assistant follows at one level of the tree

operators.name: TKS_OT_PromptToggleExpand
operators.bl_description: Show or hide the prompts of this kind. Shift, Ctrl or Alt + click: every kind

operators.name: TKS_OT_ReassignSlot
operators.bl_description: Find and reassign the matching existing slot

operators.name: TKS_OT_RefreshAllPreviews
operators.bl_description: Reload all View Layer preview thumbnails from rendered output

operators.name: TKS_OT_ReloadLinkedFile
operators.bl_description: Load this file again from disk, to get its latest changes

operators.name: TKS_OT_RenameItem
operators.bl_description:
Rename the selected item (F2).
Works in both tree view and split view.
Type to rename, Enter to confirm, Escape to cancel

operators.name: TKS_OT_RenameSlotMismatches
operators.bl_description:
Rename every mismatched slot to its target's expected name
Done per target, so it is safe for shared default names like SOLO_Nodes

operators.name: TKS_OT_RenameTagItem
operators.bl_description: Rename the active tag or group (F2)

operators.name: TKS_OT_RenderActiveVL
operators.bl_description: Render only the active View Layer

operators.name: TKS_OT_RenderJobsDragResize
operators.bl_description:
Set the popover width
Move the mouse to preview the size in the status bar
Click to apply, right-click to cancel

operators.name: TKS_OT_RenderJobsRescan
operators.bl_description: Re-check the disk for already-rendered frames of every job

operators.name: TKS_OT_ResetDirectory
operators.bl_description: Reset field to default value

operators.name: TKS_OT_RetargetScene
operators.bl_description: Move a Scene to a different Scene Group

operators.name: TKS_OT_RetargetSlot
operators.bl_description: Move a Slot to a different Action (copies animation data, deletes original)

operators.name: TKS_OT_RetargetTreeItem
operators.bl_description:
Move the selected item to a different group (Ctrl+T).
Scene → move to a different Scene Group
View Layer → move to a different View Layer Group
Scene Group → merge into another Scene Group
View Layer Group → merge into another View Layer Group

operators.name: TKS_OT_RetargetViewLayer
operators.bl_description: Move a View Layer to a different View Layer Group (within the same scene)

operators.name: TKS_OT_RetargetVLGroup
operators.bl_description: Merge a View Layer Group into another View Layer Group (same scene)

operators.name: TKS_OT_SearchRenderPreset
operators.bl_description: Search and select a render preset

operators.name: TKS_OT_SelectAllMultiselect
operators.bl_description:
Tick every visible row of the multi-selection. Rows hidden by a filter or inside a collapsed scene are left alone.
Only available while multi-select is on

operators.name: TKS_OT_SelectSceneCamera
operators.bl_description: Select the scene camera object

operators.name: TKS_OT_SelectSlot
operators.bl_description: Select an animation slot

operators.name: TKS_OT_SequencerCacheOff
operators.bl_description: Turn off this timeline's stored frames, so every strip is drawn from the take that is live now

operators.name: TKS_OT_SequencerFocusSwitch
operators.bl_description: Go to the scene that owns the strips, so the playhead has a timeline to follow

operators.name: TKS_OT_SequencerGoBack
operators.bl_description: Go back to the scene and view layer you were on before a sequencer took the window

operators.name: TKS_OT_SetAssignedTag
operators.bl_description: Set the assigned tag on a Scene, View Layer, Group, or Variant

operators.name: TKS_OT_SetRestDefault
operators.bl_description:
Set the current property value as the rest default.
Inserts a keyframe at frame 0 in the Rest State action

operators.name: TKS_OT_SetSlotOwner
operators.bl_description: Make this object the owner of the slot: the slot takes its name, and the other users share it

operators.name: TKS_OT_SetTakeMode
operators.bl_description:
Choose who owns this object's action: the takes, or you.
Auto lets the take assign it. This Take and All Takes keep the action and slot you gave it, here or everywhere.
Acts on every ticked row when multi-select is on

operators.name: TKS_OT_SGPromptPopover
operators.bl_description: Choose the prompts the assistant follows for this Scene Group

operators.name: TKS_OT_ShowLinkedFile
operators.bl_description: Show the objects from this file in the watchlist

operators.name: TKS_OT_ShowLinkedInOutliner
operators.bl_description: Select this object and show it in the Outliner

operators.name: TKS_OT_ShowOutputSettings
operators.bl_description: Show the Output settings of this scene, where the faulty output path is

operators.name: TKS_OT_ShowRenderedImage
operators.bl_description: Open the rendered image for this View Layer

operators.name: TKS_OT_SlotUsersPopup
operators.bl_description: Show every object that uses this slot

operators.name: TKS_OT_SnapAllToRest
operators.bl_description: Snap all drifted properties back to their Rest State values

operators.name: TKS_OT_SnapPropertyToRest
operators.bl_description: Snap this property back to its Rest State value

operators.name: TKS_OT_SnapSelectedToRest
operators.bl_description: Snap drifted properties on the selected objects back to Rest State

operators.name: TKS_OT_SplitAddScene
operators.bl_description: Create a new scene and add it to the selected Scene Group

operators.name: TKS_OT_SplitAddViewLayer
operators.bl_description: Create a new view layer and add it to the selected View Layer Group

operators.name: TKS_OT_SplitDuplicateSlot
operators.bl_description:
Give the selected copy its own action slot (same action)
It no longer shares animation with the object it was duplicated from

operators.name: TKS_OT_SwitchViewLayer
operators.bl_description: Switch to the specified View Layer

operators.name: TKS_OT_SyncBrackets
operators.bl_description: Convert tokens in this field to the current bracket style

operators.name: TKS_OT_SyntaxCheatSheetPopover
operators.bl_description: Show available tokens for Smart Output paths

operators.name: TKS_OT_TagAddNew
operators.bl_description: Add a new tag to the active category (Ctrl+N)

operators.name: TKS_OT_TagGroupCreate
operators.bl_description: Create a new tag group from selected tags

operators.name: TKS_OT_TagGroupDelete
operators.bl_description: Delete group and all tags inside it

operators.name: TKS_OT_TagGroupDissolve
operators.bl_description: Dissolve the group, moving its members back to Ungrouped

operators.name: TKS_OT_TagGroupMove
operators.bl_description: Move a tag group up or down within its category

operators.name: TKS_OT_TagGroupRename
operators.bl_description: Rename a tag group

operators.name: TKS_OT_TagRenamePopup
operators.bl_description: Rename this tag

operators.name: TKS_OT_TagRetargetGroup
operators.bl_description: Move tag(s) to a different group (Ctrl+T)

operators.name: TKS_OT_TakeActionNew
operators.bl_description: Create a new action and assign it to this take

operators.name: TKS_OT_TakeLiveBadge
operators.bl_description:
A Take is live on this View Layer, so its assignments win wherever it sets one.
The icons on this row still show what the View Layer itself holds.
Turn the Take off with its own checkbox to use them again

operators.name: TKS_OT_TakeNotePopover
operators.bl_description:
Add or edit the feedback note for this Take — what the review asked for this round
Earlier takes' notes show below it

operators.name: TKS_OT_TAKEPromptPopover
operators.bl_description: Choose the prompts the assistant follows for this Version

operators.name: TKS_OT_ToggleChannelMode
operators.bl_description: Toggle between Slotted Actions and Channels modes

operators.name: TKS_OT_ToggleChannelViewMode
operators.bl_description:
All Frames: show every keyed channel on the active object
Turn it off for Per Keyframe: only channels keyed on the frame you are on

operators.name: TKS_OT_ToggleGlobalRender
operators.bl_description: Toggle render state for all View Layers in ALL Scenes

operators.name: TKS_OT_ToggleGroupRender
operators.bl_description:
Toggle render on/off for all members of a group.
For Scene Groups: switches the render icon on every View Layer across all member scenes.
For View Layer Groups: switches it on every member View Layer within the scene

operators.name: TKS_OT_ToggleInspectorMode
operators.bl_description: Show or hide the manage-mode tools

operators.name: TKS_OT_ToggleOutputMode
operators.bl_description:
Toggle Standard/Compositor output mode.
Click = exclusive switch. When linked, both activate together

operators.name: TKS_OT_ToggleRenderPathMode
operators.bl_description: Switch the render folder between an absolute path and a path relative to the .blend file (//)

operators.name: TKS_OT_ToggleRenderVersionLock
operators.bl_description:
Lock or unlock the current render version as final
Detect and auto-advance never land on a locked version

operators.name: TKS_OT_ToggleSceneRender
operators.bl_description: Toggle render state for all View Layers in this Scene

operators.name: TKS_OT_UnassignAction
operators.bl_description: Clear the manual action override and restore cascade action

operators.name: TKS_OT_UnassignSlot
operators.bl_description: Clear the action slot assignment

operators.name: TKS_OT_UnassignSlotless
operators.bl_description: Remove action assignments from objects that have no matching slot (stale assignments)

operators.name: TKS_OT_UngroupScenes
operators.bl_description:
Move selected scenes back to the default 'Ungrouped' group.
Works in both single-select (active tree item) and multi-select mode

operators.name: TKS_OT_UngroupVLs
operators.bl_description:
Move selected View Layers back to the default 'Ungrouped' View Layer group.
Works in both single-select (active tree item) and multi-select mode

operators.name: TKS_OT_UnlinkTagPreset
operators.bl_description: Clear the preset assignment from this tag

operators.name: TKS_OT_UnsetRestKeyChannel
operators.bl_description:
Remove the active property's channel from the Rest State action.
Only that channel is deleted — the rest of the slot stays intact. Targets the hovered property, or the active object's transforms when run from a pie or hotkey

operators.name: TKS_OT_UnsetRestSlot
operators.bl_description:
Remove the active object's slot from the Rest State action
The object then falls back entirely to cascade-derived defaults

operators.name: TKS_OT_ValueLockKeep
operators.bl_description:
Keep
Add a keyframe for this temporary change in the current view layer
The Rest State keeps the original value

operators.name: TKS_OT_ValueLockKeepAll
operators.bl_description:
Keep All
Add a keyframe for every temporary change in the current view layer
The Rest State keeps the original values

operators.name: TKS_OT_ValueLockLetGo
operators.bl_description:
Let Go
Put this temporary change back to its original value now

operators.name: TKS_OT_ValueLockLetGoAll
operators.bl_description:
Let All Go
Put every temporary change back to its original value now

operators.name: TKS_OT_VLPreviewPick
operators.bl_description: Select a custom preview image for this View Layer

operators.name: TKS_OT_VLPromptPopover
operators.bl_description: Choose the prompts the assistant follows for this Take

operators.name: TKS_OT_VLRenderToggle
operators.bl_description:
Toggle rendering for this View Layer

Alt+Click: open the last rendered image
Ctrl+Click: render this View Layer now

operators.name: TKS_OT_VLGPromptPopover
operators.bl_description: Choose the prompts the assistant follows for this Take Group

operators.name: TKS_OT_VSW_AddCascadeProduct
operators.bl_description: Add a product to this cascade level

operators.name: TKS_OT_VSW_AddMaterial
operators.bl_description: Add a new Material Pool to the selected product

operators.name: TKS_OT_VSW_AddPart
operators.bl_description: Add a new Part to the selected product

operators.name: TKS_OT_VSW_AddProduct
operators.bl_description: Add a new Product (with base part + default state)

operators.name: TKS_OT_VSW_AddState
operators.bl_description: Add a new State to the selected product

operators.name: TKS_OT_VSW_CollectionPopover
operators.bl_description: Set collection for this product

operators.name: TKS_OT_VSW_ConflictsRescan
operators.bl_description: Re-scan pools and products for variant conflicts (flattened surfaces, shared objects)

operators.name: TKS_OT_VSW_DeleteCascadeProduct

preferences.name: sequencer_autoswitch_arrows
preferences.label: Arrows
preferences.description: Stepping the frame with the arrow keys while the mouse is over a sequencer

preferences.name: sequencer_autoswitch_back
preferences.label: Back To The Viewport
preferences.description:
Moving the mouse into a 3D viewport takes the window back
It returns to the scene and view layer a sequencer took it from
Off by default: with both halves on, the window follows your mouse between the two editors

preferences.name: sequencer_autoswitch_click
preferences.label: Click
preferences.description: Clicking inside a sequencer. The most deliberate

preferences.name: sequencer_autoswitch_hover
preferences.label: Hover
preferences.description:
Moving the mouse into a sequencer
The most eager
It acts before you press anything, which is what makes dragging the scrub bar work straight away

preferences.name: sequencer_autoswitch_play
preferences.label: Play
preferences.description: Pressing play while the mouse is over a sequencer

preferences.name: sequencer_autoswitch_scrub
preferences.label: Playhead
preferences.description: Clicking or dragging the playhead itself

preferences.name: sequencer_back_hover
preferences.label: Hover
preferences.description: Moving the mouse into a 3D viewport

preferences.name: sequencer_cache_off
preferences.label: Keep Frame Cache Off
preferences.description:
Keep the frame cache off on a timeline the follow is driving
A stored frame keeps the take it was rendered with
So it can show an old camera, animation or material before the correct one appears

preferences.name: sequencer_follow_enabled
preferences.label: Follow the Playhead
preferences.description:
While a sequencer timeline is open, apply the take state of the scene strip under the playhead
That covers its camera, action and materials
You never have to leave the timeline

preferences.name: sequencer_scene_autoswitch
preferences.label: Sequencer Scene Auto-Switch
preferences.description:
Clicking, scrubbing or playing a sequencer switches the window to the scene that owns the strips
It keeps the window there
Your viewport will change to that scene
This is what lets takes follow the playhead, because a window can only ever show one scene

items.label: Strip Animation
items.description: The copy comes through with no action. A duplicated action is deleted when it has no other users (the recorded animation does not tag along, like a fresh object)

items.label: Independent Slot
items.description: The copy keeps the same action but gets its own slot with an independent copy of the keyframes, so editing one no longer affects the other

items.label: Off (Blender Default)
items.description: Leave Blender's native duplicate behavior untouched

items.label: Gentle
items.description: Longest rests (4x each build's time) — smoothest while you keep working; the preload takes the longest overall

items.label: Balanced
items.description: Moderate rests (3x each build's time) — a good middle ground

items.label: Fast
items.description: Shortest rests (2x each build's time) — finishes soonest; best when you step away from the machine

items.label: Off
items.description: No automatic preload and no sidebar button

items.label: Automatic
items.description: Preload the scene's view layers shortly after a file opens

items.label: Manual (button)
items.description: No automatic preload; show a "Preload View Layers" button in the Takes tree sidebar to run it on demand

preferences.name: value_lock_mode
preferences.label: Value Lock Mode
preferences.description:
Value Lock Mode
Hard puts an unkeyed change back the moment you let go
Soft keeps it, marked as temporary, until you leave the view layer

properties.description: Action override for all View Layers in this group

properties.name: tks_still
properties.label: Still (View Layer Group)
properties.description: Still state for this take group: '' inherit / STILL / ANIM

properties.name: tks_parent_keys
properties.label: Inherit Parent Keys (View Layer Group)
properties.description:
Build on the keys of the tier above
Auto follows a parent that passes its keys down
On always builds on the parent
Off keeps own keys and Rest State only and cuts the chain below

properties.name: tks_parent_keys_pass_down
properties.label: Pass Down to Children (View Layer Group)
properties.description: Every tier under this one inherits this tier's keys unless it says Off

properties.name: tks_output_rule
properties.label: Active Rule
properties.description: Active automation rule for all View Layers in this group

properties.name: tks_vsw_cascade
properties.label: Group Variant
properties.description: Product variant override for all View Layers in this group (format: 'Product:Index' or multi 'P1:I|P2:I')

properties.name: tks_assigned_tag
properties.label: Assigned Tag
properties.description: Tag assigned to this View Layer group for filtering/organization

properties.name: vl_name
properties.label: View Layer Name
properties.description: Name of the member View Layer

properties.name: vl_index
properties.label: View Layer Index
properties.description:
The layer's position in the scene's list of View Layers, refreshed at every consistency check
Renaming never reorders that list, and this value is SAVED WITH the group
So an undo restores name and index together
A stale name heals to exactly its own layer instead of being paired by guesswork
